meta.description: Regionally adjusted union pay levels for yourfutureroi union-path careers
meta.formula: journeyman = state_OEWS_median x (1+p)/(1+p*u_s); apprentice_avg=0.62J, apprentice_start=0.40J, master=1.10J
notes: state_OEWS_median already captures regional wage levels; p is a regression-adjusted union premium (controls include region), so region is not double counted
(1+p)/(1+p*u_s) backs out the nonunion wage from a median that mixes union/nonunion workers (mean-based approximation applied to median)
u_s = occupation(group) national union rate x (state all-worker union rate / national all-worker rate), capped at 0.90; an estimate, not BLS-published
p: 0.25 construction/extraction (SOC 47), 0.15 other; null where OEWS suppressed the state median; annual wages exclude benefits
sources: BLS Union Members Table 3 (occupation rates, via career_classification.json)
